kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تبعثرت (form IIq)
# تَبَعْثَرْتُ (tabaʕṯartu) /ta.baʕ.θar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَبَعْثَرَ (tabaʕṯara)
# تَبَعْثَرْتَ (tabaʕṯarta) /ta.baʕ.θar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَبَعْثَرَ (tabaʕṯara)
# تَبَعْثَرْتِ (tabaʕṯarti) /ta.baʕ.θar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَبَعْثَرَ (tabaʕṯara)
# تَبَعْثَرَتْ (tabaʕṯarat) /ta.baʕ.θa.rat/: t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
